fotografia.prompt_final: Photographic system prompt for a premium B2B fintech brand visual, white institutional background, ultra-clean editorial composition with a single clear hero presence implied only through abstract industrial materiality and cost-to-variation metaphor, not a literal named object. Create a bright studio-like corporate photograph with 80–90% pure white and very light gray negative space, 6–12% deep navy used only for structural accents, contour lines, or subtle directional cues, 2–5% teal as the dominant activation color, and 1–3% coral reserved for a single tension point or future-variation highlight. Use refined real-world materials with believable texture and contact shadows: matte white ceramic, satin acrylic, brushed light metal, paper, and soft translucent overlays. Camera treatment should feel like high-end commercial photography, slightly elevated editorial angle, medium-wide framing, realistic depth of field, soft diffused light, clean reflections, moderate contrast, and precise scale relationships. Composition must be sparse, corporate, modern, international, and B2B, with one hero visual idea and at most 1–3 secondary supporting elements, leaving generous empty space for copy placement. Convey the idea of visible cost versus future variation through layered clarity: a clean, readable foreground structure, a more opaque or muted institutional layer behind it, and a sharper teal-forward solution layer that suggests control and transparency. Keep the visual language calm, premium, and trustworthy; no clutter, no decorative excess, no dramatic shadows, no dark background, no heavy gradients. Typography system only if any micro-labels are present in the design language: Montserrat Bold or ExtraBold for headline, Poppins Medium or SemiBold for supporting copy, flat vector-like matte lettering in navy, with teal and coral used minimally for emphasis. Background style must remain white, luminous, and institutional, with soft contact shadows and precise editorial spacing. Overall feeling: clear, premium, controlled, and financially intelligent, with the brand’s transparency contrasted against opaque legacy banking.
fotografia.negative_instructions: No text, no legible words, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no watermarks, no invented data, no gibberish, no misspellings, no fake UI, no third-party brands, no generic stock photo look, no Canva-style composition, no clutter, no collage, no three-column layout, no catalog grid, no dark background, no neon, no crypto aesthetic, no gamer aesthetic, no cartoon style, no toy-like materials, no cheap plastic, no low-poly look, no CGI render look, no overdesigned infographic, no excessive navy, no excessive teal, no excessive coral, no thick arrows, no busy charts, no multiple competing focal points, no inconsistent scale, no distorted perspective, no harsh bloom, no messy reflections, no overexposed white clipping, no fake corporate smiles, no visible faces as a primary solution, no awkward hands, no floating objects, no surreal mechanics, no generic business icons, no invented symbols, no watermark, no brand marks.
fotografia.creative_rationale: This prompt preserves the same commercial intent while translating it into a reusable photography system: premium white institutional lighting, clear hierarchy, strong negative space, and a transparent-versus-opaque financial metaphor. It stays within Xending’s B2B fintech visual DNA and avoids naming any concrete subject so it can be reused across different pieces.
